summary: SunCar Technology Group Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (SDA), furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that its board authorized an open-market share repurchase program for up to $10 million of its Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001. The program runs approximately three months from the November 6, 2026 announcement and is to be funded from cash on hand plus operating cash flow. Repurchases may occur on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions under Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18. No price per share, premium, or advisor was specified; watch execution pace and any trading-volume constraints.
